Subject: Debrief: Aria Kovács (Sr Runtime) — recommendation to extend

Hi Lauren & Marissa,

Looping you both with the interview notes from Thursday’s loop for Aria Kovács (attached: interview notes, candidate scorecards). Quick summary and recommendation:

- Overall: Strong across system design and kernel-level optimizations; excellent latency debugging examples.
- Culture/Team fit: collaborative, good communicator, has led open-source runtime patches previously.
- Recommended level: IC4 (Senior Runtime Engineer) — leaning toward an elevated comp placement given competing offers.
- Suggested comp package (based on market + committee): Base $205,000, target OTE (base + target equity vesting) ~ $275k, equity ~0.45% RSU 4-year schedule. Signing bonus: discretionary (discuss below).

This candidate has a live counter-offer from another startup with a higher cash component. We think a small above-band base (approx +10% above midpoint) plus a modest signing bonus will secure the candidate without setting a precedent for the role.

Attachments: aria_kovacs_resume.pdf, comp_grid_q3_2027.xlsx, interview_scorecards.pdf

Next step: Marissa — can you start the offer packet and request approval for an elevated base (comp exception) to $205k + 0.45% equity? Ben — I’ll need finance sign-off on the exception. Stephanie — please confirm legal/terms language if we include a signing bonus clause.

Thanks,
Tessa

> Interview highlights and raw scorecards attached.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Offer prep — Aria Kovács (SR Runtime) — request for comp exception approval

Hi Ben & Lauren,

Per the debrief below, the hiring committee is requesting an above-band base for Aria at $205,000 (approx +12% over band midpoint) and equity at 0.45% RSU. We are also proposing a $10,000 signing bonus to counter a competing cash-heavy offer.

Why this exception?
- Candidate is mission-aligned and would materially shorten ramp on several kernel/throughput projects.
- Market comps (attached spreadsheet) show peers in similar roles at comparable costs but with higher cash mixes.
- We believe the blended comp (higher base + modest signing bonus) is the least inflationary path to close.

Requested approvals:
1) Ben — finance approval to offer base $205,000 (exception to the IC4 band). Please confirm any spending constraints or required pre-approvals.
2) Lauren — hiring manager sign-off on leveling and proposed equity %.
3) Stephanie — legal sign-off if we include a $10k signing bonus clause and a standard retention repayment schedule in case of early departure.

Attachments: comp_grid_q3_2027.xlsx, offer_template_sr_runtime.docx

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa,

I reviewed the comp grid and the business case. Finance is comfortable approving the requested base of $205,000 and 0.45% equity for this hire given projected ROI on the infra projects cited. Please note the following:

- Approver note: Approval contingent on offer including a 1-year retention clause for the signing bonus repayment schedule (standard HR template).
- Please cap the total first-year cash (base + signing) at $215,000 for payroll forecasting.

You’re green to proceed — Marissa/Tessa, final offer packet can be routed to candidate once HR adds the retention clause and Legal confirms the signing bonus language.
